findings.text: the production dispatch path builds PickRequest with no capability, so _request_requirement returns None and outcomes_at_requirement is never populated on a live pick, leaving the block inert outside replay until the declared capability is wired onto the live request.

a request naming no requirement yields no block at all rather than a pooled fallback, so a live pick shows the candidate no requirement-scoped history and the fallback rows remain an undecided question.
